title: Jon Martin — Free HubSpot Health Audit and Fixer
description: A free HubSpot health check, scored against 11 years of what I've seen break in real portals. It never changes anything in your portal unless you turn fixes on.
heroTitle: Know what's wrong in your HubSpot portal. Then fix it.
subhead: AI is the lens. The standard is mine: the best practices and the problems I've seen over 11 years across B2B SaaS, B2B services, custom manufacturing, and the companies that work inside and on top of HubSpot. Portal Audit turns that into a scored report and a 90-day plan, and never changes anything in your portal unless you turn fixes on. Portal Fixer then applies the safe cleanup items from that plan, and shows you every change before it happens.
offerStatement: The audit never changes your portal. Fixes are optional, and you see every change first.
whoParagraphs: HubSpot admins at smaller companies who inherited the portal, or run it next to another job, and want a straight answer on what needs attention.
Agencies and consultants who manage HubSpot for clients. The first audit for each portal is free, so run it on a client portal before you scope the work.
checks: Data model: unused and duplicate-looking properties, custom objects, association labels.
Pipelines: your deal and ticket stages.
Data quality: how complete the key fields are on contacts, companies, deals and tickets. It uses counts, not copies of your records.
People and access: owners, roles, super admins, and paid seats nobody has used in 90 days.
Marketing and automation: lists, forms, emails and workflows, if your plan includes them.
Security and limits: login activity, an audit-log summary, and account limits.
checksConvergence: 46 automated checks and 37 best-practice tests, ending in a plan for the first 30, 60 and 90 days. The tests aren't generic. They're the patterns I've learned to look for over 11 years, run through automation.
fixerHeading: The audit reads. Fixer writes, and only what you approve.
auditPoints: Reads your settings and counts records.
Never creates, changes or deletes anything.
Gives you a scored report and a 90-day plan.
fixerPoints: Re-reads the portal and shows a dry-run preview of the change.
Reads each value back after writing, and restores the snapshot if it doesn't match.
Never deletes or merges records, turns on a workflow, or sends email.
fixerNote: Fixer covers a short, published list of fixes. Anything else on the report stays with you. Independent apps, not made or endorsed by HubSpot.
startBody: It's free for your first portal and starts with one install. Want it to keep watching? Watch reruns the audit every month, or every week, and emails you the report. Fixer comes after, if the plan has fixes you want applied.
